items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: Louis Armstrong and old man King Oliver didn't have nothing on my trumpet player and they used to come down there Louis, King Oliver and his whole band would come and watch us.

ctx.x: Yes, he's got him all right. He's doing pretty good.

He had the willpower. He was in Charlotte than anybody ever seen to have a stroke and go in and come out. So as I said, Johnny Dot, Baby Dot, and Louis Armstrong, the King Oliver, and the fellow who played trombone with them, I can't think of his name. Lil Armstrong was on piano then when they first came here.
